propositions: Whole-tree fixture helpers export all 3,019 checkout files when production hatch_build.py only requires hatch_build.py, pyproject.toml, and src/rebar/__init__.py, causing unnecessary session fixture initialization on all three xdist workers with 6.60-6.74s setup each

Artifact-probe uses workflow GITHUB_SHA instead of deriving final checked-out HEAD via git rev-parse --short HEAD and asserts truthiness rather than exact equality, accepting wrong but nonempty trusted-main SHA on Gerrit patchsets violating exact-source identity contract

Shared minimal committed Hatch package fixture with copied production hook through real isolated PEP 517 sdist-to-wheel boundary reduces per-worker setup from 6.60-6.74s to 2.20-2.88s and selected-six serial elapsed from 18.23s to 9.11s while preserving all semantics and env/fallback/blank-env probes
Both artifact workflow lanes must derive expected commit SHA via git rev-parse --short HEAD after final lane-specific checkout and require exact equality for installed wheel and sdist distributions
